title: pyrostria subsessilifolia
intro: Pyrostria subsessilifolia, commonly known as the Madagascar fire bell, is a plant species native to Madagascar and is part of the Rubiaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pyrostria subsessilifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds that exhibit therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and fighting oxidative stress.
